"""Tests for muse_client.py key loading."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

import muse_client
from muse_client import BASE_URL, ENV_FILE, KEY_NAME, PLACEHOLDER, load_api_key, read_key_from_env_file


def _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    """Write text with default encoding."""
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def test_read_simple(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Plain KEY=value is parsed."""
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    _write(p, "MODEL_API_KEY=abc123\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) == "abc123"


def test_read_bom_quotes_spaces(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """BOM, spaces around =, and quotes are handled."""
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    p.write_bytes("\ufeffMODEL_API_KEY  =  \"secret-xyz\"  \n".encode("utf-8"))
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) == "secret-xyz"
    p2: Path = tmp_path / ".env2"
    _write(p2, "MODEL_API_KEY='q'\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p2) == "q"


def test_read_empty_returns_none(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Empty value returns None."""
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    _write(p, "MODEL_API_KEY=\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) is None


def test_read_missing_returns_none(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Missing file returns None."""
    assert read_key_from_env_file(tmp_path / "nope.env") is None


def test_read_ignores_other_keys(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Other keys are ignored."""
    p: Path = tmp_path / ".env"
    _write(p, "OTHER=1\nMODEL_API_KEY=good\n")
    assert read_key_from_env_file(p) == "good"


def test_env_priority(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    """Environment beats the file."""
    monkeypatch.setenv(KEY_NAME, "env-key")
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: "file-key")
    assert load_api_key() == "env-key"


def test_placeholder_rejected(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    """Placeholder key raises RuntimeError."""
    monkeypatch.delenv(KEY_NAME, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: PLACEHOLDER)
    try:
        load_api_key()
        assert False, "expected RuntimeError"
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        msg: str = str(exc)
        assert msg.startswith("MODEL_API_KEY is not set")
        assert "https://dev.meta.ai/api-keys/" in msg
        assert ".env" in msg


def test_missing_key_message(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    """Missing key mentions URL and file."""
    monkeypatch.delenv(KEY_NAME, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: None)
    try:
        load_api_key()
        assert False, "expected RuntimeError"
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert str(exc).startswith("MODEL_API_KEY is not set")
        assert "https://dev.meta.ai/api-keys/" in str(exc)


def test_file_key_used_when_env_has_placeholder(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    """A real key in the file is used when the environment holds the placeholder."""
    monkeypatch.setenv(KEY_NAME, PLACEHOLDER)
    monkeypatch.setattr(muse_client, "read_key_from_env_file", lambda *args: "file-real-key")
    assert load_api_key() == "file-real-key"


def test_base_url_correct() -> None:
    """Base URL points at Meta."""
    assert BASE_URL == "https://api.meta.ai/v1"
    assert ENV_FILE.name == ".env"
    assert os.environ.get("UNUSED_SENTINEL_XYZ") is None
